latest_release.name: Release v8.0 🎈
latest_release.body:
# Release 8.0 [Changelog](https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/compare/v7.0...v8.0)

**Huge thanks to contributors for making this theme better :)**
**Also a Big Thank You to supporters at [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/adityatelange) and [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/adityatelange). Kudos to you guys** :heart_decoration:


## What's Changed
* change \<del> element CSS styling to use line-through by @dubbl in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1181
* Add condition to disable edit post on md file by @douglastofoli in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1143
* Allow loading cover from /assets folder by @timonback in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1187
* Updating pagination strings for pl by @Nevalicjus in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1229
* Bump GitHub workflow actions to latest versions by @deining in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1267
* feat: allow hiding author in post_meta by @0x2E in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1250
* feat: add configurable limit to search results by @pottekkat in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1281
* Highlight.js -> Hugo's chromastyles by @adityatelange in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1364
* Do not use `site.BaseURL` in templates by @ytrepidorosonomous in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1368
* Adding xmlns:content namespace to RSS feed and only write content:encoded if something on .Content by @DJLink in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1411

### Bug Fixes
* Fix RSS link for paginated list pages by @bkrl in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1192
* socialIcons, fix: apply safeURL to make all URI schemes work by @deining in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1266
* fix: Font size in the code block may be larger on iOS Safari by @shimoju in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1285
* Fix/hugo depr 0.120.x by @adityatelange in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1328
* Fix hugo build fail due to "expected comma" error by @sebinbabu in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1461
* Fix copyright field rendering in RSS feed by @KonishchevDmitry in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1479


### Icons
* Add social icon for VK by @geeqla in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1171
* Add social icon for substack (#1129) by @shivan-s in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1197
* Add social icon for Threads by @geeqla in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1256
* Add social icon for Tidal by @rolandtjr in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1259
* Social Icon for Google Play Store by @tarakparab in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1242
* feat: add wechat icon by @zhengbangbo in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1149
* add social icon of leetcode by @yifu-yang in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1286
* Add the social icon for Firefish by @coxde in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1294
* Add the social icon for Pleroma by @coxde in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1293
* [feature] Add codeberg icon by @thanosapollo in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1310
* feat: add bugcrowd and intigriti to svg.html by @kev-odin in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1205
* Add svg for X by @zanseb in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1273
* Add Wordpress Icon by @theJoshMuller in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1114
* Add the social icon for Bluesky by @shimoju in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1383
* add social icon of juejin by @barnett617 in https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/pull/1347
* Add Git SVG icon by @iamluc
